title: Retrospective study on the prevalence of different subtypes of small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and large cell neuroendocrine lung carcinoma (LCNEC) and their impact on prognosis
summary: In small-cell and large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the lung, there are various immunohistochemical subtypes that are currently not yet differentiated in standard diagnostics. The aim of this study is to determine the frequency of these different subtypes and to investigate their impact on prognosis.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of bronchus and lung

interventions.name: histologic blocks of patients with SCLC/LCNEC

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Histologically confirmed neuroendocrine lung cancer
